message: Vector Rebel 3.2.61: automatically populate the real Vector SCBA FAILURE DETAILS notes and failing airpack selection.
releaseNotes: SCBA airpacks default to Pass / Present / Working: one choice maps to all 11 verified native SCBA template 113271 questions. Fail / Issue or Missing expands a compact 11-question Pass / Fail review and mandatory equipment comment. Specific answers are transferred into the official Vector form when fully reviewed, while unanswered checks are left for manual completion. Live Vector failure details modal was inspected on Voyager: choosing Failed opens a required Failure Notes field and an item selection. Rebel now fills that native field from the exception comment and chooses the exact failed SCBA item. The inspector reviews and submits the final native dialog. No inspection is auto-submitted.
